about_the_game:
Welcome to Your New Career as an Investor!

"The Beginner Investor" is an engaging economic simulator that puts you in the shoes of a budding investor. Start with a small amount of cash and a simple computer in your apartment. Your goal is to study the market, make smart decisions, and grow your portfolio into a vast fortune.

Key Features:

  • 🛒 Buy & Sell Stocks: Trade shares of dozens of unique companies across different economic sectors. Each has its own risk and reward profile.

  • 📈 Build a Diversified Portfolio: Don't put all your eggs in one basket! Invest in growth stocks, reliable dividend payers, and safe bonds to protect your wealth from market crashes.

  • 🌐 React to the Market: Dynamic events and news will affect stock prices. Can you anticipate the market and buy low before everyone else?

  • 📊 Watch Your Wealth Grow: See your progress come to life with clear charts and graphs tracking your net worth, profits, and passive income.

  • 🏡 Live the Investor Life: A simple life simulation ties it all together. Work your day job to get seed money, pay rent, and spend your hard-earned cash on life's comforts.

This is your chance to learn the basics of investing in a risk-free, fun environment. Do you have what it takes to build an empire from the ground up?

Wishlist today!
